notes: 10-op negative-bias subnormal-bitcast quadratic exp2(x/2)^2 kernel (beats 11-op incumbent and 13-op literature_best; 63,866/65,536 exact, max 1 ULP, 6 constants). Shifts the IEEE-754 exponent bias by -2^31 (-129*2^23 = -1082130432) so x in [-254, 130] maps to negative int32 bit patterns representing -2^(x/2) while x < -254 (all the way to -Inf) underflows ftoi_round's [-2^31, 2^31) guard directly to 0, eliminating the lower max(x, -150) clamp completely; squaring (-2^(x/2))^2 = +2^x strips the sign bit and handles normals, subnormals, underflow, and overflow in 1 mul.
